lead.headline: Louisiana re-inspected only 90 of 182 hazardous-waste manufacturing plants in five years, last of 28 states; median 91.8%
lead.number: 90 of 182 (49.5%) got another full on-site inspection in the five years to July 2026; next lowest Illinois 62.7%, Texas 66.5%
lead.watch_out: An approved alternative compliance-monitoring plan would make this legal; not checked. Louisiana's small-generator inspections more than doubled over the same years.
